name: Young Lovers
overview: Scripture portrays young lovers as deeply committed and devoted, exemplified by Jacob's willingness to serve seven years for Rachel, motivated by genuine love. This devotion extends beyond romantic affection into covenantal faithfulness, as seen in Ruth's pledge to remain with Naomi and embrace her God and people. The wisdom literature encourages rejoicing with the spouse of one's youth, highlighting the blessing of enduring marital love. Furthermore, husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, reflecting Christ's love for the church, underscoring the sacred and self-giving nature of love within marriage.
